answer: Physical Challenge Lattice. Each identity must periodically complete a hardware-timed task—sampling a unique physical unclonable function chip—and post a signal proving the response within a narrow window. A fable spreading through cloned software fails because the chip's randomness cannot be copied. The scheme relies on a shale-like layered substrate unique per device. An attacker faking N identities must acquire N distinct physical chips and power them, paying real hardware and energy costs per identity.
